trade_distance.title: Stay in trade range
trade_distance.how: Play beside or just behind a teammate, close enough to swing onto their killer within two seconds. Never more than one corner away from the nearest one.

play_with_entry.title: Pair with your entry
play_with_entry.how: When the team takes space, be the second player in. Your job is the trade on the entry's fight, not a separate angle on your own.

info_before_peek.title: Get information before you peek
info_before_peek.how: Utility, sound or a teammate's call first. A dry peek into an angle you know nothing about is a coin flip.

follow_entry.title: Move toward the contact
follow_entry.how: When a teammate fights near you, go toward the fight at once, crosshair where the killer has to be. Waiting for the call is too late.

use_utility_to_peek.title: Take the first duel with utility
use_utility_to_peek.how: Flash yourself in or ask for one, or smoke the crossing. Take opening duels with an advantage, or let them come to you.

play_the_advantage.title: Play the man advantage
play_the_advantage.how: After the opening kill, slow down: regroup, trade, use the numbers. Hunting alone gives the advantage back.

regroup_after_opening.title: Regroup after the opening
regroup_after_opening.how: Call the kill, take the space it opens together with your team, and avoid a second dry duel.

clutch_time.title: Use the clock in clutches
clutch_time.how: Play for information and time. Take the duels one at a time, from positions they have to come through, and make the defuse or the plant their problem.

use_utility_before_death.title: Throw your utility before the fight
use_utility_before_death.how: If you are likely to take a duel, throw your grenades first. Utility left on your body is money and help lost for the team.

call_your_flashes.title: Call your flashes
call_your_flashes.how: Say "flashing" before you throw, and throw past your teammates' line of sight, not across it.

change_position.title: Change your position
change_position.how: The opponents have read this spot. Play another position on the same site, or the same one from another angle.

change_timing.title: Change your timing
change_timing.how: Same spot, another moment: earlier, later, or only after utility. Break the pattern they expect.

trade_timing.title: Train the trade swing
trade_timing.how: On retake or 5v5 servers, swing right after your teammate's contact, within one to two seconds. Rewatch the rounds above and note when you could have swung.

prefire.title: Prefire the routes you play
prefire.how: Yprac Prefire (Workshop) on this map: clear every angle of your usual routes until no bot surprises you. 10 minutes before playing.

retake_servers.title: Play retake servers
retake_servers.how: Many short 1vX situations: focus on using the clock and isolating one fight at a time.

aim_botz.title: Aim Botz, first bullet
aim_botz.how: Aim Botz (Workshop), 10 minutes a day: 100 kills standing still with the first bullet at head height, then 100 after a counter-strafe.

crosshair_placement.title: Crosshair placement
crosshair_placement.how: Walk the map with the crosshair at head height on every angle, then play deathmatch thinking only about where your crosshair is before the enemy appears.

counter_strafe.title: Counter-strafe
counter_strafe.how: In a private server or a counter-strafe trainer from the Workshop: strafe, tap the opposite key, shoot one bullet. The shot must land once you are stopped.

lineups.title: Learn your lineups
lineups.how: Yprac or a lineup map for the map you play most: two smokes and two flashes per site you play, so your utility goes out before the fight.

pop_flashes.title: Pop flashes
pop_flashes.how: In a private server: practise flashes over the walls and corners you play, bursting before an enemy can turn, and away from your teammates.
